decision: Shared Maple/LFM active text training uses causal token-to-neuralese mapped drift adaptation followed by the canonical full-depth autoregressive feedback fixup, then exact-weight runtime and recurrence qualification. There is no active sketch text-training variant.
sequence: Gold-history full-stack pass, then one full-stack consumer pass over detached mapped previous-token embeddings; no future input positions.

input_map.identity: raw token embedding plus zero-initialized causal depthwise convolution and low-rank residual
input_map.target: current full-depth projected output at the matching target slot, detached
input_map.consumer_gradient: detached; map trained only through its own self-consistency objective

full_projection.target: fixed raw next-token embedding table, always independent of the detached map target
full_projection.training: full-strength embedding loss from the first update; full-stack next-token CE after the projection phase

schedule: Fresh map starts projection-first; measured held plateaus precede gentle transformer adaptation. Passing the schedule is not qualification.

continuation.weights: restore full backbone and all heads, including newly frozen feedback weights
continuation.optimizer: Restore full optimizer state when trainable groups match; fresh map initialization adds parameter groups and requires an explicitly recorded fresh optimizer. Subsequent map and AR-feedback resumes preserve complete compatible optimizer state.
continuation.qualification: new objective remeasures baseline and resets projection plateau and qualification evidence

supervision: shared TEXT_SUPERVISION_POLICY; real open/close boundaries; system prompt stays context-only
qualification: Full projection remains measured against raw gold embeddings; mapped-history alignment is only text qualification. Actual autoregressive blocks, stopping, transport, gradient replay and function recurrence require exact-weight independent qualification.
residual_caveat: A token-derived map cannot carry information beyond tokens. Measure projection-versus-map residual and qualify self-generated block exposure before functional recurrence training.
serving: omit the training-only input map from serving heads; preserve it separately in exports and full resumable checkpoints
